exposure: previous described risk factors for nosocomial bacteremia
multimodal intervention (education, insertion checklists, central line maintenance and access guidelines, late onset sepsis antibiotic treatment adjustments, diaper bags)
outcome: bacteremia caused by vancomycin-sensitive Enterococcus faecalis (VSEfe)
cohort: The study included 30 consecutive neonates with VSEfe bacteremia from a tertiary-care neonatal unit, matched with control neonates for gestational age, birth weight, and year of birth.
finding: WGS typing identified the outbreak of VSEfe bacteremia as predominately nonclonal, and a multimodal intervention successfully terminated the outbreak by reducing its incidence.
